retrievalProfile.description: A multi-layered urban collage featuring high-contrast portraits, halftone textures, and bold gradient-filled block lettering set against a stylized cityscape.

recipe.visualDefinition: A dense, vibrant composition combining a central male portrait in sunglasses with a background of green-tinted cityscapes, orange-tinted silhouettes, and a prominent street sign, all unified by a coarse halftone print texture and bold, drop-shadowed typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject portrait anchored to the left foreground
Stylized orange silhouette framing the right side
Diagonal street sign intersecting the vertical cityscape
Bold typography layered over a radiating green burst
coreInvariants: Coarse halftone dot texture across all photographic elements
Heavy drop shadows on all graphic and text elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Primary subject occupies the left two-thirds of the frame, medium close-up scale.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and sunglasses serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the subject's face to the street sign, down to the bold typography, and then to the orange silhouette on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is a 'horror vacui' style collage with overlapping elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Desaturated olive green for the cityscape and background textures.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant orange-yellow for the secondary silhouette and highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast with crushed blacks and blown-out highlights, typical of xerographic or screen-print styles.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters filled with vertical linear gradients
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single bold display face paired with a utilitarian condensed sans-serif for secondary signage.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and blocky presence.
Modern geometric alternative with similar proportions.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a digital collage with a man in aviator sunglasses on the left, a green-tinted cityscape in the center, and an orange-tinted silhouette of legs on the right. Apply a coarse halftone dot texture and high contrast to the entire image.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, lowercase block text in the bottom right corner using a red-to-yellow gradient fill and a heavy dark drop shadow. Include a diagonal green street sign graphic in the upper right.

verificationChecks: Is the halftone texture visible across the portrait?
Does the text have a multi-colored gradient and heavy shadow?
Is the color palette dominated by green and orange tones?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Verify the gradient direction in the text
Ensure the street sign is at a diagonal angle
Confirm the subject is high-contrast and desaturated
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Collage = (High-Contrast Portrait + Halftone Cityscape) * (Vibrant Color Tints) + (Bold Gradient Typography with Heavy Shadows)
